# v1.0.0 - First Stable Release

## Overview
TrinovaRobot-IoT v1.0.0 marks the first stable release of an IoT-enabled robotics control system built with C++ and PlatformIO.

## Features
- **Core Robotics API**: Complete abstraction layer for robot control (IRobotDriver interface)
- **FreeRTOS Architecture**: Multi-task design with MotionTask and SafetyTask on dual cores
- **Hardware Support**: 
  - DC Motor Driver (PWM control)
  - PCA9685 PWM Servo Controller
  - Hardware abstraction for real robot control
- **Safety & Monitoring**:
  - Motion safety with clamping and timeout protection
  - Watchdog service
  - Battery monitoring
  - Diagnostics service
- **IoT Connectivity**:
  - WiFi manager with reconnection backoff
  - MQTT client with Last-Will-Testament (LWT)
  - OTA updates via HTTP triggered by MQTT
  - Offline message buffering with ring buffer
- **Command & Control**:
  - JSON-based command processing
  - Telemetry publishing
  - State machine implementation
- **Development & Testing**:
  - Native unit testing framework
  - GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline
  - Comprehensive architecture documentation

## What's Included
- Complete FreeRTOS-based multi-tasking architecture
- Real hardware driver support (DC motors, servos, PWM controllers)
- Robust IoT communication stack
- Production-ready safety mechanisms
- Automated build and test pipeline
